title: Say Kamarerwa ed Likod na Idolo
intro: Diad anino na baleg ya impaway manlapud panagpairap, sayan misteryoson pigura so manaalagar ed kalawakan. Legan ya say lider na pinilin totoo et tinmatdang ed sagradon palandey parad madibinon komunyon, baleg a subok so sinmabi ed saramay atilak. Inanamot na sayan indibidual so panaon pian umanen so sisiaen na interon komunidad. Nen pinmawil so lider ya walaan na katuaan, walay nikadkaduman dusa tan andi-anggaan ya ingganggan. Sarag mon amtaen no siopa yan kontrobersyal tan masilib ya too?
clues: Akila ak ed saray totoon nibulos ed pakayari na sakey a makapanyarin managpairap diad panamegley na saray mamilagron tanda.
Nen linmad palandey so lider da pian mangawat na panangigiya, nanalagar ak ed limog na saramay atilak.
Nantipon ak na mablin metal manlapud saray alahas da tan pinorma ko itan pian magmaliw a makapawala na tanol.
Diad panamegley na sayan pinalsa, akombinse ko so interon kailalakan ya aromog da so dios da ed kalawakan.
Nen pinmawil so lider, siak so pinili tan tinepetan no antoy amakiwas ed siak ed ontan a panagpalikdo.
Say dusa ed sayan mundo et anggapoy maniwit ed siak odino onasingger, sakey a tanda na kababaingan ya awiten ko ed andi-anggaan.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say Samiri
Propeta Musa
Saray managsalamangka nen Faraon
Si Haman, ministro nen Faraon
Si Iblis, say impulisay

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say impanggawa ed balitok a baka
Say impitongtong ed si Faraon
Say impamaalagey na baleg a biong
Say ag-inmabuloy ya ondakmomo ed arap nen Adan
Say inkaderal na saray syudad nen Lut
trial.answer: Say impanggawa ed balitok a baka

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a balitok ya kilaw a baka
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a kabatyan a kamelyo ya pinmaway ed bato
Sakey a biong ya impaalagey ed palandey
Sakey a trono ya ipapaarap na dagem
location.answer: Sakey a balitok ya kilaw a baka

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nakondena ya ag nadiwit, ya andi-anggaan ya ibabaga ton 'ag makapitongtong'
Nalner a kaiba so managpairap tan say armada to
Ibantak ed apoy ya nagmaliw ya ambetel tan mareen
Nabulag lapud agto inawat so katuaan
Tinaynan ed sakey a abot na maimon iran kakanayon
outcome.answer: Nakondena ya ag nadiwit, ya andi-anggaan ya ibabaga ton 'ag makapitongtong'

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
